messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy window opens in ~8m. Rolling plan: 7% -> 30% -> 100% (4m stages). Preflight snapshot: p95=108ms, errors=0.03% (SLO 0.1%). This rollout touches rerank+embed. Reply :go_for_it: to start.
jen: starting watches. If embed 5xx > 6/min or p95 > 160ms auto-pause and tag @platform-oncall.
platform-oncall: Oncall here. If pause, rollback target v2026.02.28 is staged and ready.
mike: Shifted traffic to 7% at 1745556799. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/rollouts/1745556799
obs-bot: SOFT ALERT at 1745556815  embed-route 5xx = 9/min. Action: HOLD rollout at current stage. :warning:
jen: grabbing traces. Early signs point to Redis KV miss amplification causing extra embed calls. Increasing kv.local_cache_size=256 on canary nodes and enabling sticky prefill.
platform-oncall: Good mitigation. If error rate not <5/min in 5m we perform rollback. Pre-staged rollback command is ready (`/deploy rollback v2026.02.28`).
mike: Adding note to release notes: "paused at 7% due to transient embed 5xx; applied KV cache bump; monitoring 5m."
obs-bot: UPDATE at 1745556840  embed 5xx down to 3/min, p95=120ms. Recommendation: RESUME to next stage. :white_check_mark:
jen: +1 to resume. Keeping high-fidelity traces for 10m post-resume.
platform-oncall: Resume to 30% at 1745556850 per consensus. Tagging ops for a short post-deploy investigation.
release-notes-bot: Release notes updated: "Paused briefly during canary for KV miss spike; mitigation applied; rollout resumed to 30%."
